stable.notes: Choose the live preview model (Whisper Turbo or Parakeet Ultra) and the HQ model from Settings, and install Parakeet. Pairs with server 6.73.1: timestamped Large-v3 HQ, highpass front end and a speech-detector quiet gate. Parakeet Ultra preview measured 10.7% fewer errors than Turbo on silver; Turbo stays the default. Matched companion 6.10.639 adds the phone switcher. Signed and notarized by Apple.

whatsNew.summary: Choose your transcription models and install Parakeet Ultra. Pairs with server 6.73.1 and companion 6.10.639.

sections.title: Transcription models
items: Settings has a Transcription card. Pick Whisper Turbo or Parakeet Ultra for the live preview and the HQ model for saved meetings, and see which engine is actually running.
Preview changes apply to the next live chunk and HQ changes to the next saved meeting. Nothing switches in the middle of a meeting.

sections.title: Parakeet Ultra
items: Install Parakeet from the card: about 654 MB, every file checked, runs offline on the Neural Engine.
On our silver set Parakeet Ultra as the live preview had 10.7% fewer errors than Whisper Turbo. Turbo stays the default.

sections.title: Server 6.72.0
items: Saved meetings use timestamped Large-v3 with correct word times, a highpass-only front end, and a speech detector for quiet chunks.
Older phones keep Turbo previews. Dictation is unchanged.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
